title: stenorrhynchos calcaratum
intro: Stenorrhynchos calcaratum, commonly known as the clubbed Stenorrhynchos or Slipper Orchid, is a species of orchid native to tropical Asia. This plant is known for its unique, slipper-shaped flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits. The health benefits of Stenorrhynchos calcaratum include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help soothe wounds and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial and antioxidant effects.
